notes.title: Game title changed to "Wound of the West"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302832/48363af6c080968d29a5c6ab37fb17a338bbb3aa.png[/img]

Dear Fans,

Since I have been notified that the title "Wounded Knee" is very offensive and misleading to public according to the tragic event in US history, I've made up my mind and hereby announce that this game's title will now on be changed to "Wound of the West".

Thank you for everyone's support and understanding.

Best,
Yui
